title: Zero-1-to-3: Zero-shot One Image to 3D Object ( Stable Diffusion based code available )
author: fisj

comments.author: [deleted]
comments.body: sooooooooooooooo can i export these objects as 3D asset files?

replies.author: fisj
replies.body:
Not yet. If you check out the project site, they have examples of their one shot model results, and they're still pretty blobby. What this technique does is to take an input image, and guess what it should be like as a complete 3d object.

Combine this with a more tuned, version of stable diffusion and I kinda expect this would be a path to generating 3d models. Its one possible path to generating 3d models. There's other approaches too, so I'm optimistic we'll see 3d models being done with generative AI soon. Heck, Adobe yesterday basically announced they were working on it and expect it to be a product in the future.
